spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता or -ती तं)
Of a variegated colour.
(-तः-ता-तं)
Arrived, come.
m. (-तः)
1 A deer or antelope.
2 A variegated colour.
E.
इण to go, तन् affix; when signifying colour, the fem. affix is either टाप् or ङीप्, and before the latter, त is changed to न.

pron. mfn. (एषः एषा एतद् or एतत्)
This.
E.
एत derived from इण to go, and तद् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-नः)
Expiration, breathing out, discharging air from the lungs.
E.
इण to go, तनन् aff.

ind.
Now, at this time.
E.
एत substituted for इदम्, and र्हिल aff.

m. (-शः)
A Brahman.
E.
इण to go, and तशः Uṇādi aff.

m. (-शाः)
A Brahman or man of the first class.
E.
इण to go, तशस् aff.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Such, such like.
E.
एतद् this, दृश् to see, क्किप् aff.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Such, such like.
E.
एतद् this, दृश to see, कञ् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
So many, so much, so far.
ind. (-वत)
So far, thus far, so much, &c.
E.
एतद्, and मतुप् or वति aff.
